fact: GeezLab's GLaRe programme lists open Tigrinya datasets, including the TiNC24 NER corpus (200K+ words) and the TiPOSC24 part-of-speech corpus (118K+ tokens), both led by students at Mai Nefhi College of Engineering.
GeezLab lists Dahlak LMs, a family of language models trained on Eritrean languages, as in progress.

Six Eritrea Institute of Technology (Mai-Nefhi) computer-engineering graduates built a Tigrigna speech-to-text prototype as a senior project, with a new dataset of almost 30 hours of voice data from 25 male and 26 female speakers, and plan to develop it further.
